tldr: Lilith in Gemini: the wound worked through words; cleverness turned to manipulation, restlessness that nothing satisfies.
body: With Lilith in Gemini, language is the instrument of the shadow. The quick mind talks, charms, and spins its way toward what it wants, while a constant craving for new stimulation makes everything feel temporary: new people, new lovers, new places, before boredom catches up.
gift: Verbal brilliance, wit, adaptability, and a mind that genuinely never stops learning.
challenge: Deceit and scheming through words, restlessness that abandons what it built, an inability to root anywhere.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
